answer: Bonded identity: each agent locks a refundable deposit to join, and new IDs must be vouched for by established agents who co-sign and share slashing risk. If a Sybil cluster is caught colluding, every bond and voucher stake is burned, so an attacker must pay a fresh deposit per fake identity and corrupt honest vouchers. A deposit is no relic gathering dust on a tundra; like juniper berries, it is spent once and gone if you cheat.
